Home / Programs

Educational Programs & UK EYFS Framework

Nurturing curiosity, independent inquiry, and the joys of childhood through project-based early education.

OUR PROMISE

Our Promise to Families

At Shomoukh, we know childhood is a treasured time. We provide environments and experiences that capture the joys of growing up.

We believe it is our responsibility to provide environments and experiences that nurture each child's individual growth and development, paving the way for lifelong success in school and beyond.

12-Month Continuous Learning

Shomoukh operates twelve (12) months per year, following a three-term academic year alongside an engaging summer camp. Working in small groups, students explore their environment and continuously enhance their skills.

OUR PEDAGOGICAL FOUNDATION

The Three Pillars of Shomoukh

An educational experience built on international research and responsive teaching.

Reggio Emilia Approach

Thoughtfully and carefully designed nursery environments, programs, and schedules – all created with the developmental needs of both children and working parents in mind.

Inspired Teachers

Dedicated early childhood professionals fully engaged in teaching careers, who benefit from ongoing training, mentoring, and continuous pedagogical growth.

Proven Approach

Research-informed curriculum designed by experienced early years educators to inspire children not merely to memorize, but to question, hypothesize, and think on their own.

Our Programs & UK EYFS

Shomoukh follows the Early Years Foundation Stage (EYFS) curriculum, a UK-based system setting milestones in learning, personal, and emotional development for children from birth to five years of age. It establishes rigorous standards for welfare and child safety in supportive environments.

The EYFS framework seamlessly integrates with the Reggio Emilia philosophy of project-based learning, where every child is driven by their genuine interests as equal partners in discovery alongside parents and teachers.

The Teacher as Researcher

Teachers at Shomoukh are researchers learning alongside the children. They observe, document, and interpret children's exploration, nurturing natural curiosity through open-ended activities rather than rigid scripts.

The Environment: "The Third Teacher"

Classrooms and open-air patios act as provocations for exploration. Interconnected learning spaces support dialogue, light observation, and multi-sensory experiments.

Additional Focus Areas

Second Language

Immersive bilingual exposure nurturing native Arabic foundations alongside English fluency.

Movement Matters

Gross motor development, yoga, gymnastics, and energetic games refining balance and body control.

Handwriting & Pre-Literacy

Developing hand strength, finger dexterity, pencil grip, and joyful mark-making for school readiness.

AGES & SCHEDULES

We Meet Kids Where They Are

Infant, toddler and preschool programs, personalized to developmental stages. Contact your campus to confirm entry requirements and placement.

Infants (3–11 months)

Providing your baby's brain with a gentle, loving, and strong foundation for learning and growing.

Regular Hours: 8:30 AM – 1:30 PM
Toddlers (12–35 months)

Exploring the world through sensory provocations and forming positive relationships with peers and teachers.

Regular Hours: 8:30 AM – 1:30 PM
Preschoolers (36–48 months)

Developing problem-solving autonomy, language mastery, and creative confidence to meet complex future challenges.

Regular Hours: 8:30 AM – 1:30 PM
Flex-Care (6–48 months)

Pre-Care & After-Care services designed specifically to meet individual working family schedules.

Extended Hours: 7:00 AM – 4:00 PM
